premise: The light turns copper-red; Robot dashes about telling everyone the Sun is broken; Pilot sits him down to watch the Earth pass in front of it.
inspiration: Henny Penny ('the sky is falling!'), turned: someone stops running and looks.
learning: In an eclipse seen from the Moon, the Earth hides the Sun and the light turns red from all the Earth's sunsets.

en-US.title: The Day the Sun Went Out
en-US.text: {canvas:eclipse 18s} [surprised] The light turned red. Copper-red, like an old penny. {solar-panel:enter} The solar panel tilted about, {solar-panel:live} hunting for the Sun. {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} Robot {robot:spin} panicked. [rushed] The Sun is broken! {geologist:enter} {robot:go to geologist} He dashed to Geologist. The Sun is broken! {geologist:face surprised} {pilot:enter} {robot:go to pilot} He dashed to Pilot. The Sun is BROKEN! {pilot:face happy} Pilot just smiled and patted the rock beside him. Sit. Look. {robot:face normal} Robot looked. The Earth was sliding in front of the Sun. [whispers] An eclipse, said Pilot. That red light is every sunset on Earth — and every morning's first light — all at once, shining through its air. {robot:face surprised} Every sunset at once? said Robot. {geologist:face happy} Nobody said a word after that. They just watched. And when the Sun came back, {robot:face happy} {robot:live} Robot danced to welcome it.

es-ES.title: Cuando se apagó el Sol
es-ES.text: {canvas:eclipse 18s} [surprised] La luz se volvió roja. Rojo cobre, como una moneda vieja. {solar-panel:enter} El panel solar se inclinaba {solar-panel:live} de un lado a otro, buscando el Sol. {robot:enter} {robot:face surprised} Robot {robot:spin} se asustó. [rushed] ¡El Sol se ha roto! {geologist:enter} {robot:go to geologist} Corrió hasta Geólogo. ¡El Sol se ha roto! {geologist:face surprised} {pilot:enter} {robot:go to pilot} Corrió hasta Piloto. ¡El Sol se ha ROTO! {pilot:face happy} Piloto sonrió y dio unas palmaditas en la roca de al lado. Siéntate. Mira. {robot:face normal} Robot miró. La Tierra se estaba deslizando por delante del Sol. [whispers] Un eclipse, dijo Piloto. Esa luz roja son todos los amaneceres y todos los atardeceres de la Tierra a la vez, brillando a través de su aire. {robot:face surprised} ¿Todos los atardeceres a la vez? dijo Robot. {geologist:face happy} Después de eso nadie dijo nada. Solo miraron. Y cuando volvió el Sol, {robot:face happy} {robot:live} Robot bailó para darle la bienvenida.
